reasoning: The evaluation identified 4 major defects and 2 minor defects. Major issues include severe table structure corruption on page 2 (tabular data converted to an ordered list), improperly flattened lists, loss of critical text formatting (bold/underline for meeting access details), and retained header/footer elements. With 4 major defects, count-based routing rules require routing to HUMAN_REVIEW.

concerns.analysis: The source document features a 3-column tabular layout (Tab, Topic, Presenter) that spans across both pages. While Page 1 correctly structures this as a table, Page 2 completely abandons the table structure and converts the continuing rows (items 6 through 15) into an ordered list. This merges previously distinct column data (Topic and Presenter) into single text strings and entirely drops the 'Tab' numbering for the items.

concerns.analysis: Several lists in the document have been improperly flattened into plain text rather than being structured as HTML list elements. Similarly, on Page 2, bulleted items under 'PSAP Grant Program Progress Reports' are concatenated into a single string with Unicode bullets instead of a nested sub-list.
